canonical_name: No Supplier Service Monitoring and Review
description: Supplier service delivery is not regularly monitored, reviewed, and audited for security compliance.
applicability: Applies when an organization does not have established processes to regularly monitor, review, and audit supplier service levels and information security practices to ensure ongoing compliance with security requirements and contractual obligations.

metadata.detection_notes: Review supplier performance monitoring procedures, verify existence of regular security reviews, check audit schedules and findings, assess change management processes for supplier services, examine incident tracking and resolution with suppliers.
